proposals.economic_premise: The identical spot asset can trade at different executable prices on independently operated central limit-order books because venue access, capital segmentation, latency, inventory location, fiat rails, and operational risk limit immediate law-of-one-price enforcement. Aurex would test only pre-funded same-asset dislocations and would never treat unmatched last trades, candles, or post-trade transfers as an arbitrage fill.
proposals.ex_ante_payoff_direction: When the executable bid on one accessible venue exceeds the executable ask on another, simultaneously sell pre-positioned base inventory at the high bid and buy the same quantity with pre-positioned quote inventory at the low ask. Net payoff exists only if both acknowledged fills complete and the locked spread exceeds both venue fees, adverse movement, partial-leg rollback, inventory rebalance, custody, and capital costs.
economic_reason_edge_might_persist: Capital and inventory cannot move instantaneously across separately operated venues, so local order flow can temporarily segment prices.
Jurisdiction, account access, counterparty, custody, fee tier, and operational constraints can limit competing arbitrage capital.
proposals.execution_path: Maintain base inventory on the prospective sell venue and quote inventory on the prospective buy venue. At a later separately frozen decision event, compare synchronized non-stale executable top-of-book prices and quantities, submit bounded IOC or FOK legs with unique client IDs, reconcile acknowledgements and fills independently, cancel or flatten any unmatched residual under a predeclared rollback path, then reconcile venue balances before another attempt. Transfers are inventory rebalancing events, never assumed atomic trade legs.
proposals.pre_return_falsification_condition: Reject before primary selection if Aurex cannot qualify a synchronized 2023-2024 same-asset BBO archive with quantities, exchange and local timestamps, disconnect or sequence recovery, and point-in-time venue rules for two legally accessible accounts; if historical fees and filters cannot be bounded; or if a deterministic two-leg acknowledgement, partial-fill rollback, inventory, balance, and reconciliation model cannot be proven without real orders.
independence_from_blocked_lineages: It does not forecast price direction and does not express trend, breakout, path quality, broad beta, clock phase, or reversal.
It is inventory-backed spot execution and does not use funding, perpetual basis, borrow, or passive market-making compensation.
This is same-asset law-of-one-price enforcement across venues, not V3P01 cross-asset cointegration, hedge-ratio estimation, or spread mean reversion.

primary_sources.title: Trading and arbitrage in cryptocurrency markets
supported_claims: Capital controls, capital location, fees, and limits to arbitrage are material to interpreting those deviations.
Cryptocurrency markets exhibited recurring cross-exchange price deviations and market segmentation.
explicit_limitations: The study used historical Kaiko trade data and does not prove a current executable Aurex edge or current account access.

primary_sources.title: Binance Spot API WebSocket Streams
supported_claims: Depth reconstruction has explicit snapshot, update, and connection-limit semantics.
The bookTicker stream publishes best bid and ask prices and quantities with an order-book update identifier.
explicit_limitations: Current mutable documentation is not point-in-time proof of the 2023-2024 schema, fees, filters, or venue state.

primary_sources.title: Coinbase Exchange WebSocket Channels
supported_claims: Coinbase publishes BBO fields and sequence-aware level-two or full order-book feeds.
The order lifecycle includes received, open, match, change, and done events, and dropped-message recovery matters.
explicit_limitations: Current mutable documentation does not establish historical availability, account eligibility, fee tier, or schema.

primary_sources.title: Tardis downloadable CSV market data documentation
supported_claims: Raw replay can preserve disconnect events that normalized CSV quote files omit.
The vendor documents tick-level quotes, order-book updates, trades, exchange timestamps, and local receipt timestamps.
explicit_limitations: Availability, completeness, subscription cost, checksums, and exact Binance/Coinbase coverage require a separate bounded census and transport contract.

source_feasibility_contract.missing_event_policy: Never infer, forward-fill, interpolate, or backfill a BBO, quantity, sequence, disconnect, or venue state. Any unexplained event-sequence gap invalidates the affected session; any failed calendar coverage gate rejects the proposal before primary selection.
source_feasibility_contract.source_revision_policy: Freeze endpoint identity, dataset revision, content length, and available checksum before payload access. A changed or absent revision requires a terminal transport-stop result, never silent replacement or continuation.
source_feasibility_contract.pre_return_source_stop: Stop if a separately frozen metadata census cannot prove the exact two-venue 2023-2024 archive scope, or if a bounded payload pilot cannot prove schema, timestamp, disconnect, sequence, and checksum integrity without inspecting bid, ask, size, trade, P/L, or return values.

execution_feasibility_contract.pre_return_execution_stop: Reject if either venue is not legally and operationally accessible, point-in-time fees or filters cannot be bounded, pre-funded inventory is impractical for the intended capital, or Aurex cannot deterministically reconcile both legs, unknown orders, partial fills, balances, residual exposure, and rollback without assuming atomic execution.

proposals.economic_premise: Option buyers may pay a persistent premium for convex protection against large cryptocurrency moves, creating a variance risk premium for capitalized sellers who absorb jump, volatility, skew, and liquidity risk. Aurex would test a delta-hedged option exposure, not forecast the underlying price and not equate quoted implied volatility with an executable return.
proposals.ex_ante_payoff_direction: A short delta-hedged option exposure can earn only when collected executable option premium exceeds realized gamma hedging losses, option and hedge-leg fees, bid-ask spread, discrete hedging error, jumps, settlement costs, margin drag, and liquidation losses. The payoff is negatively convex and can suffer losses much larger than routine gains.
economic_reason_edge_might_persist: Capital, margin, model, liquidity, and operational constraints can limit competition in crypto option supply.
Protection demand can compensate option sellers for bearing crash, jump, volatility-of-volatility, and skew risk.
proposals.execution_path: A later separately frozen protocol would construct one predefined delta-hedged option exposure from executable bid prices, hedge its underlying delta with a specified future or perpetual using executable quotes, update hedge state only under frozen rules, settle fees and cash flows in their actual currencies, apply point-in-time margin and liquidation, and close or cash-settle all legs with deterministic position and balance reconciliation. No mark, midpoint, or model Greek may be used as an assumed fill.
proposals.pre_return_falsification_condition: Reject before primary selection if Aurex cannot qualify complete 2023-2024 Deribit option-chain quotes, sizes, trades, instrument lifecycle, underlying hedge quotes, settlement, fees, and margin state; if the archive omits disconnect or revision evidence; if the operator cannot legally access the venue; or if deterministic multi-leg fills, delta accounting, cash flows, liquidation, expiry, and reconciliation cannot be proven before any return test.
independence_from_blocked_lineages: Delta hedging targets first-order direction and does not use trend, breakout, reversal, path-quality, beta, or clock-phase signals.
It is an options risk-premium mechanism, not V3P03 passive spread capture or queue-position market making.
The premise is compensation for transferring option convexity and tail risk, not spot-perpetual funding or basis carry.

primary_sources.title: The Bitcoin VIX and its Variance Risk Premium
supported_claims: High-frequency option observations and realized variance are required to measure the mechanism.
Peer-reviewed research constructs Bitcoin implied-volatility indices and studies variance risk premia from Deribit options.
explicit_limitations: A variance-risk-premium estimate does not prove a tradable short-option strategy after spreads, hedging, margin, and tail losses.

primary_sources.title: Deribit Institutional Account Setup Guide historical data
supported_claims: Deribit documents public historical trade and instrument endpoints and states that instrument history is retained.
Historical endpoints expose exchange-native instrument and trade records for later bounded feasibility work.
explicit_limitations: The guide does not provide sequence-complete historical BBO or prove complete option-chain quote coverage.

primary_sources.title: Deribit public get instrument API reference
supported_claims: Instrument identity is required to reconstruct option lifecycle and cash-flow semantics.
Instrument records include option type, strike, expiration, contract size, settlement, tick size, and state.
explicit_limitations: Current API documentation is not proof of point-in-time 2023-2024 specifications or later revisions.

primary_sources.title: Tardis downloadable Deribit options datasets
supported_claims: Daily files and exchange-native raw replay can support a bounded source census and disconnect-aware pilot.
The vendor documents grouped Deribit option quotes, option chains, trades, order books, and local receipt timestamps.
explicit_limitations: Exact availability, subscription cost, completeness, revision identity, and payload integrity are unqualified.

primary_sources.title: Deribit fees and delivery fees
supported_claims: Current fee tiers are scheduled to change, demonstrating that point-in-time fee history is mandatory.
Options and hedge instruments have product-specific trading, delivery, liquidation, and fee-cap semantics.
explicit_limitations: The current page cannot be projected backward as the exact 2023-2024 fee schedule without dated archive evidence.

source_feasibility_contract.missing_event_policy: Never infer, interpolate, forward-fill, or backfill an option quote, size, trade, Greek, instrument, underlying hedge quote, disconnect, fee, or margin state. Any unexplained sequence or lifecycle gap invalidates the affected session; failed coverage rejects the proposal before primary selection.
source_feasibility_contract.source_revision_policy: Freeze vendor exchange metadata, available-since and available-to fields, source revision, content length, and available integrity headers before payload access. A changed source ends in a preserved transport-stop result unless the predeclared contract permits and verifies the exact replacement.
source_feasibility_contract.pre_return_source_stop: Stop if a separate metadata census cannot establish complete daily grouped option, underlying hedge, instrument, and rule coverage for 2023-2024, or if a bounded checksum-aware payload pilot cannot prove schema, timestamp, lifecycle, disconnect, and cross-product identity without inspecting prices, Greeks, signals, P/L, or returns.

execution_feasibility_contract.pre_return_execution_stop: Reject if venue access is unavailable, complete point-in-time fees, settlement, margin, liquidation, and contract state cannot be bounded, or Aurex cannot deterministically model executable multi-leg fills, Greeks and cash flows, discrete hedging, expiry, liquidation, balances, and worst-case tail-loss controls.

screened_out_theories.reason: This is another simultaneous law-of-one-price multi-leg mechanism with the same order-book synchronization, fee, partial-fill, and rollback core as V4P01. Registering it separately would spend a proposal slot on a closely related execution family.

Put-call parity uses the same option-chain, underlying hedge, multi-leg execution, margin, and settlement foundation as V4P02. It may become a non-return data-quality diagnostic but is not an independent primary theory in this round.

Direct issuer mint and redemption access, banking rails, limits, settlement timing, compliance, and counterparty terms are not credible assumptions for Aurex today. Exchange-only premium trades would not reproduce the redemption mechanism.

A directional post-liquidation rule would likely choose continuation or reversal from outcomes and overlap retired trend, path, breakout, or reversal families. It lacks one independent pre-outcome payoff direction suitable for this bounded round.

limitations: Commercial data access, account access, and required starting capital remain unresolved costs rather than hidden assumptions.
Cross-venue arbitrage requires pre-funded inventory, legally accessible accounts, synchronized executable BBO, and deterministic two-venue failure reconciliation.
Current exchange and vendor documentation cannot be projected backward as point-in-time 2023-2024 execution truth.
Development outcomes, validation, holdout, forward, Pine, paper, sandbox, live trading, and capital permissions remain false.
Every payload request requires a separate frozen crash-safe transport contract with cumulative request, byte, timeout, retry, resume, persistence, and terminal-stop budgets.
Neither proposal is selected; source and execution feasibility may still reject both and close V4 with zero primaries.
No price, quote value, quantity value, parameter, signal, trade, P/L, strategy outcome, or return was inspected or calculated.
One of three proposal slots is deliberately unused because adding a related or operationally inaccessible theory would inflate multiplicity without adding an independent mechanism.
Registration freezes two theories and their no-return feasibility requirements; it does not claim either mechanism has current edge.
Variance-risk-premium exposure is negatively convex and requires complete option quotes, hedge execution, margin, settlement, and tail-loss evidence; routine premium collection is not safe income.
